title: SearchDocument
description: Canonical schema for a document indexed by dsearch. This schema defines the stable external shape of indexed content.

title.description: Short human-readable title used for ranking and display.

content.description: Primary text content indexed for lexical and semantic search.

metadata.description: Optional low-cardinality metadata associated with the document.

createdAt.description: Optional document creation timestamp (ISO-8601, UTC recommended).

updatedAt.description: Optional document last-update timestamp (ISO-8601, UTC recommended).
